title: Milestone 3: Interface and Report
prompt: Build summarize(tasks) -> dict with keys total (all) and open (done == 0); and main(argv, repo) dispatching: ['add', title] → service add via repo, print 'added', return 0; ['list'] → print each open task's title in order, return 0; anything else → error to stderr, return 2. Both functions annotated (main returns int).

tests.name: add path prints and exits 0
tests.code:
class Repo:
    def add(self, t):
        return 1
import io, contextlib
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    code = main(['add', 'write tests'], Repo())
assert code == 0 and 'added' in buf.getvalue()
tests.hint: Dispatch 'add' through the service idea: print confirmation, exit 0.

tests.name: list prints open titles in order
tests.code:
class Repo:
    def list_open(self):
        return [{'title': 'a'}, {'title': 'b'}]
import io, contextlib
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    code = main(['list'], Repo())
assert code == 0
assert buf.getvalue().split() == ['a', 'b']
tests.hint: One title per line, list_open order.

tests.name: usage errors to stderr, exit 2
tests.code:
class Repo:
    pass
import io, contextlib
err = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
    code = main(['nonsense'], Repo())
assert code == 2 and err.getvalue().strip() != ''
